title: Low Poly
look: Faceted shading in hard diagonal bands, like a low-polygon model.

doc.essence: Four hard bands of the same hue across every shape, lit from the top left, read as facets.
doc.notIt: Not soft-gradient: no smooth ramps, no glow.
doc.colour: Each area gets lighter / light / base / darker bands.
pitfalls: Very small parts show one band only: that is fine.
